{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend structured blazer, tailored fit, knee-length, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy weave.
Cotton-poplin classic collar shirt, regular fit, hip-length, crisp white (#FFFFFF), woven cotton.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight leg, ankle-length, midnight blue (#191970), stretch twill.
Leather loafers with a low block heel, pointed toe, chestnut brown (#8B4513), smooth calfskin.
Gold-plated geometric stud earrings and a slim silver chain necklace.
This ensemble balances the rock venue's energy with her request for a restrained and classic look by using a structured blazer and refined wool textures rather than flashy prints. The dark navy trousers provide depth to stand out in low artificial club lighting while maintaining an elegant silhouette suitable for standing in a crowd. Neutral tones anchor the outfit, allowing it to feel timeless and appropriate for a formal smart dress code without overshadowing the event's atmosphere."}
